title: 1.4 One or Two? More Actions
unit_outcome: Understand and say short German sentences about people and what they are doing.
goal: Say what one person or two people are doing with rennt/rennen, sitzt/sitzen, schwimmt/schwimmen and schläft/schlafen.
grammar_function: Person + singular verb; person und person + plural verb; sie + singular vs plural verb.
prerequisite: German 1.1-1.3: the four people, der/die/das, und, and sie for one or two people.
speaking_outcome: Say what one or two people are doing with four new actions.
